earlier_scan.source_named: Glottolog Glottolog's most extensive descriptions are wordlists only (Bender 1997/98; Evans-Pritchard 1932); no grammar or phonology of Kelo exists.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x reference list for kelo1246 and for Eastern Jebel (east2386) / Aka-Kelo-Molo (akak1254)
sources.note: Bibliographic only: 8 refs for Kelo, none a grammar or phonology beyond Bender 1997/98; family node adds only Gaam works and 19th-20th c. ethnography/wordlists.

sources.citation: Stirtz, Timothy M. 2012. A grammar of Gaahmg, a Nilo-Saharan language of Sudan. Utrecht: LOT (PhD Leiden). (archive.org item 351-gaahmg, scanned text)

sources.note: Phonology is of Gaahmg only; Kelo is mentioned solely in the classification paragraph (pp. 16-17, citing Bender 1998:39). Nothing on Kelo prosody.

sources.note: Nothing on Kelo.
